name: MergeVille
storyline:
In MergeVille, you follow the story of Olivia, a talented fashion designer who returns to her cute hometown, Lakeview, to reconnect with her dad, Jacob. While Olivia is totally stoked to be back in Lakeview, she's also got the tough task of creating a new clothing collection that will be the talk of the town.

But finding inspiration for her designs isn't easy. That's where you come in! As Olivia's spirit, you'll go along with her on her journey to explore the town and find the inspiration she needs. You and Ryan, Olivia's childhood friend, will uncover the secrets of Lakeview and meet a bunch of cool characters along the way.
summary: MergeVille is a puzzle business farming game where you become the Mayor of your very own town and merge various animals and objects to upgrade them.
